sources.title: Heat Ready London
sources.verified_claim: Heat Ready London sets a shared cross-sector vision for adapting the capital to increasing heat risk after record heat in May 2026. Citywide heat risk and actions do not establish overheating conditions at a sample parcel.

sources.title: Heat Ready London - London’s first ever heat plan - sets out new vision to protect the capital from extreme heat
sources.verified_claim: City Hall reports one million London homes may be at high overheating risk and identifies priority actions around vulnerable people, buildings, cooling spaces and infrastructure. London-scale estimates are not parcel-level heat modelling.

sources.title: Cool spaces – criteria for 2026
sources.verified_claim: The 2026 criteria define accessibility and amenity requirements for Tier 1 and Tier 2 indoor cool spaces. A validated cool-space network is public-health resilience context, not evidence of a parcel's thermal performance.

sources.title: The London Climate Resilience Review
sources.verified_claim: The Review assesses London climate resilience and makes 50 recommendations following heat and flood impacts. Strategic recommendations do not establish exact parcel exposure or resilience.

sources.title: Climate action
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's current climate page describes its updated Climate Action Plan, carbon-neutral targets and building/energy programmes. Borough climate action does not establish parcel_30762 overheating or adaptation performance.

sources.title: What we are doing to care for our environment
sources.verified_claim: Havering states its refreshed environmental action plan runs through 2027 and reports current practical energy and resilience actions. Borough programme status is not parcel_46142 heat-risk evidence.

sources.title: Lambeth: Supporting the community through extreme heat
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth described heat-response measures during a June 2026 alert, including libraries and leisure centres as cool spaces. Emergency response context does not establish parcel_61522 overheating or cooling capacity.

sources.title: Cool Spaces Directory
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's directory lists indoor cool spaces and explicitly states they provide respite rather than medical care. Proximity or listing is not automatically inferred for the sample parcel without exact spatial matching.
